records.summary: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles discussed decision-making at end of second quarter halftime.
records.source_excerpt: In his halftime interview with NBC, Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said that he didn't go for a touchdown to close the second quarter largely because his team was going to receive the second-half kickoff with a chance to double up.
